title: Jack Rees's Classic Cabaret on State Street
summary: The band was hired under contract by Jack Rees for his cabaret in Chicago. They talk about its location and the white Purple Derbies band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Classic cabaret. I'll have to, frequently in all telephone books I can find out the exact location, the telephone number. and address. But Ohio on State. That's where it was. On the corner? It's about the second door from the corner. Which corner, do you remember? Going east. North or south? East.
Going east. Going towards the lake.
Going east on the south side or north side of the street?
It was on the east side of the street. It was on the north side going...
Near the northeast corner. North, northeast corner.
Jack Rees, classic cabaret. Yeah, yeah. And is this where they had a, they also had a white band?
That's the same place, Purple Derbies.
Purple Derbies was the name of the band? That was the name of the band.
Yeah. You don't remember anybody in that band?
I can't remember those fellas. They saved my life.
Did Jack Reed bring you up from Louisville or did you come on the chance that you'd pick
up a cab? No, he brought us a cab. Brought you up. We had a contract for that job.
